other_conditions: The individual applicant must be an Indian citizen
The applicant must be the Project Leader of the proposed project
The applicant must be incubated in a recognised incubator and provide a Letter of Intent or MoU with that incubator
If employed by an academic or research organisation, the applicant must submit a No Objection Certificate permitting individual funding and the use of a separate no‑lien account
If employed by a for‑profit company/LLP, the applicant must either resign/retire (submit resignation/relieving/retirement letter) or apply under the company/LLP route
Promoter‑shareholders of a biotech company or partners in a biotech LLP cannot apply as an individual (must apply through the company/LLP route)
Company/LLP must be registered under the Companies Act and incorporated no earlier than 5 years before the call date
At least 51 % of the company's capital must be beneficially owned by resident Indian citizens or Indian companies
The Company/LLP must have an in‑house functional R&D facility or be incubated at a recognised incubator
The Project Leader must have completed basic undergraduate training in any discipline
BIG support can be provided only once to any individual or start‑up
Scientists, faculty, research scholars and graduates are eligible if they intend to incubate at a bio‑incubator
benefits_summary: Grant‑in‑aid of up to INR 50 lakh for a maximum of 18 months, together with continuous mentoring, IP, legal, networking, training and other support services.
documents_required: Letter of Intent (LoI) or MoU with incubator
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employing academic/research organisation
Resignation/relieving/retirement letter (if employed with for‑profit company)
